description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hadirawalana Ihalagama, Kurunegala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420350
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and property details. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses entirely on land registration and title settlement processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
